Man Detained After Forcing Entry into Delhi Airport Terminal

A man was detained at Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport after he forcefully entered Terminal 3 by jumping over a wall. Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) personnel intercepted him within seconds of his breach. The incident led to a high alert at the airport. The man, identified as being from Haryana, reportedly did not have valid documents for entry.
